results.title: The Waiter
results.overview: After losing his Job his wife, and his daughter, Frank takes a job as a waiter but the relentless cruelty and humiliation from the staff push him past his breaking point, sending him on a violent, vengeful rampage.

results.overview: Connie and Larry Van Oosten are jolted awake by a masked gunman standing at the foot of their bed. Abducted from their home and locked inside a hidden bunker, the couple must endure days of torment.

results.overview: Michaela Kiersch goes on a global sending spree, becoming the first woman ever to climb both V15 boulders and 5.15 routes.

results.title: Khadam
results.overview: After her mother's death, a woman inherits a supernatural entity that mirrors her in perfect form — then begins taking over her role as wife and mother.

results.title: Ang Modista
results.overview: A provocative story about a seamstress who uses her body to attract more customers, until the arrival of one man that changes her life forever.

results.title: Solo Mission
results.overview: Deep beneath the earth, a lone operative infiltrates a decaying Cold War bunker on a final seek-and-destroy mission. Cut off from command and low on ammo, he fights through ruthless guards to trigger the facility’s self-destruct. As alarms scream, a calm, waiting adversary blocks his escape. What follows is a brutal confrontation between two men, trapped by ideology and time, as the countdown to annihilation begins...

results.title: TNA No Surrender 2026
results.overview: No Surrender 2026 was a professional wrestling event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) that took place on February 13, 2026 at The Pinnacle in Nashville, Tennessee, USA, and was headlined by Eddie Edwards & Nic Nemeth vs. Leon Slater & Mike Santana in a Tag Team Match.

results.title: Sick
results.overview: During the summer holidays, sixteen-year-old Maks and his older sister Emmaare sent to the Polish countryside to care for their ailing grandmother.  Trapped together in the heavy, stifling isolation of the summer heat, the siblings’ bond begins to shift into something unsettling and difficult to define. As tensions rise and boundaries begin to blur, their grandmother’s frail presence takes on an increasingly disturbing quality, turning a once-idyllic summer into a haunting passage into adulthood.

results.title: Vomit
results.overview: Wildcard addict on the run from trouble shows up bloodied and battered at the door of his home health aide ex-girlfriend, turning both their lives upside down in this super dark comedy about love, death, drugs, and ferrets.

results.title: Hunky Jesus
results.overview: A feature documentary that explores the legacy of the San Francisco chapter of the Sisters of Perpetual Indulgence, a global, secular order of queer and trans "nuns" who combat guilt, shame, and exclusion through joy, humor, activism, and irreverence, serving their communities while challenging bigotry and redefining spirituality.

results.title: Alea Jacarandas
results.overview: In the streets of Algiers, jacaranda trees bloom like shards of memory. Following in the footsteps of his father, Ameziane, a writer haunted by these purple trees, Hassen Ferhani explores the city, legacy and love. A rich and intimate quest in which writing, filming or choosing beauty become acts of resistance.

results.title: The Perfect Lie
results.overview: Clara leads a seemingly perfect life with a successful career and her charming boyfriend, Tobias. But when she runs into Katrine by chance, the facade begins to crumble. For despite their differences, the two women discover they have one thing in common: Tobias. For years, they’ve both been in a relationship with the same man. Clara’s world comes crashing down, and in her search for the truth, she becomes entangled in an inscrutable game where the lines between truth and lies, desire and deception blur—and where it becomes increasingly difficult to determine who is actually manipulating whom.

results.title: The Coohatch
results.overview: While surveying a newly purchased plot of land, Ricky Noble, an amateur developer vanishes.  Thought dead, his friends and family struggle to move on when suddenly he returns with no memory of what happened.  As Ricky becomes increasingly disturbed by images of a supernatural entity – the family is forced to confront an unknowable terror.

results.title: Happily Married
results.overview: Anis and Anamika are complete opposites, brought together by an unexpected marriage. Can the responsible Anis and the free-spirited, modern Anamika overcome their differences and build a happy life together?

results.title: Let Our Mountains Live
results.overview: Sami reindeer herders win a Supreme Court victory against Europe’s largest wind farm - but when the state refuses to act, their fight reveals a deeper crisis of justice and trust.
